text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Calstone Light O—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Are you good at claw crane 
games?
choice_data_list:
I wouldn't say I'm good at it... just 
average, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll be blunt. Please teach me how to do 
that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Calstone Light O 
pointed, there was a claw machine filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I happened to receive one the other day, 
but... having just one on the desk feels 
so incomplete!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Lining them up in a straight line is truly 
the way to go. That's what I thought, and 
decided to give it a try, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see. I should at least be able to give 
you a lecture on how to do it.
choice_data_list:
If that's the case, maybe I'll give it a 
try!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
! Thank you. I will watch closely, look 
straight at you, and commit it to memory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
